title: Building a Machine
subtitle: Fit a part, then screw it in
text:
Place a chassis and right click it with each part in turn. A part sits loose until you use the screwdriver on it.

0 Chassis  1 Assembly  2 Control board  3 Upgrades (optional, up to 2)  4 Panels  5 Worktop

Sneak with the screwdriver to take the last part off. Breaking a part-built chassis drops its parts.
caption: Exploded view, parts in order

steps.title: Parts in order
steps.text: Right click with the part, then the screwdriver. Skip the upgrades if you like.
